name: LUNA

description.short: Modern corset mermaid gown with premium floral lace, tulle, and dramatic over-skirt.
description.full:
Pricing & Availability

  • Made to Order: ₱22,000
  • Size: Small to Medium (Onhand) | Custom size available

Details

  • Style: Modern Corset Mermaid with Over-skirt
  • Fabric: Premium Floral Lace & Tulle
  • Color: White
  • Design: Intricate lace with a structured silhouette

Features

  • Structured Corset Bodice: Features visible boning for a snatched, modern fit.
  • Elegant Lace Sleeves: Long, off-the-shoulder sleeves covered in delicate floral lace.
  • Layered Silhouette: A fitted mermaid base paired with a voluminous lace over-skirt for extra drama.
  • Intricate Lace Details: Full-body floral appliques that flow from the bodice down to the trail.
  • Grand Lace Trail: A sweeping, lace-trimmed train perfect for a grand entrance.
  • Customizable Trail: Trail length can be adjusted for Made to Order (MTO) requests.
  • Adjustable Back: Ensures a flawless and comfortable fit for all sizes.

priceMessage: Message us on Facebook for inquiries on custom measurements or to start your order!
